messages:
aline: FYI - noticed flaky duplicate POSTs from the Android SDK when network toggles quickly on Pixel 7 with Retrofit + OkHttp. Happens in our sample-app during onboarding flow.
drew: can you repro deterministically? any stack traces or logs?
aline: pretty reproducible. steps: enable cert pinning, start app with poor signal, then flip airplane mode off/on. logs show 3 nearly-identical requests within ~100ms after reconnect. looks like retry/backoff not respected.
nina: screenshots of log? maybe our RetryAndFollowUpInterceptor is cloning the request body incorrectly for streaming bodies?
aline: paste: 
```
I/OkHttp: --> POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/session  (id=0x7f3)
I/OkHttp: --> POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/session  (id=0x7f3-clone)
I/OkHttp: --> POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/session  (id=0x7f3-clone-2)
W/Retrofit: call canceled? fallback to retry policy.
```
drew: interesting. our CallAdapter for suspend functions wraps calls and attempts a manual retry on IOException; combined with OkHttp's internal follow-up it may double-retry. we used to rely on OkHttp only.
nina: Right — with suspend adapter we do: try { call.await() } catch (e) { if (retryable) call.clone().await() } which is fragile for non-idempotent endpoints.
aline: So two issues: (1) we have duplicate retry responsibilities (adapter + okhttp), (2) pinning+handshake can cause connection to be replaced and okhttp issues follow-ups that also trigger our adapter.
drew: propose fixes: (A) move retry responsibility solely to OkHttp layer and remove clone-based retry in CallAdapter, (B) add an idempotency token header in SDK for session/create to make accidental duplicates safe, (C) instrument a small emulator test that toggles network and asserts <=1 server-side create.
nina: +1. For (B) we can generate X-Idempotency-Key in SDK when caller doesn't provide one. That avoids changing server.
aline: Also add a quick check to the adapter: if call.isExecuted() then don't call.clone() for retry; that prevents races where the original is still finishing.
drew: I'll sketch a patch. Tiny snippet: 
```
// in suspend CallAdapter
if (call.isExecuted) return call  // avoid cloning a running call
// else proceed with enqueue/await
```
nina: Can you add a test for Android 12 and 13 emulator images? I can add a GCloud matrix job for pixel-7a on both.
drew: Will raise a PR with: remove adapter-level retries, add idempotency header, adapter defensive check. Will mark WIP and add test plan.
build-bot: Job queued: android-network-flaky-smoke #9002 (matrix: pixel-7a:12,pixel-7a:13)
aline: Thanks — also file an SDK parity note: callers of Java SDK (non-suspend) need to know we removed adapter retry and must rely on OkHttp configs. I'll add an entry to CHANGELOG under "java/kotlin sdk".
drew: once CI passes we'll cut a patch 0.14.2. Backport to 0.13.x if it affects enterprise customers.
aline: created GH issue linking sample-app repro and test plan. tagging @nina for CI setup.
nina: copying CI matrix config into the issue.
aline: sweet. thanks all.
